extractor_notes:
The access control is recorded in its own fields this time, including that it is on by default and that the subscriber cannot disable it. Both of those are separate questions from whether a lock exists, and in an earlier run of this case the whole fact survived only as prose in a notes field.

o8 is the pairing the vocabulary used to lose: sexual slavery is REFERRED TO and nothing is shown. is_depicted is false and treatment records the fictional framing. Neither fact displaces the other now.

The certificate is entered twice because the field holds one scope each and the source gives 'cinema and home video' as one certificate with two. This would double-count under any rule that counts certificates.
